_readme: DRAFT endpoint registry for the Neuron Outcome Atlas (docs/MVP_V0.md §4). It has not been reviewed by a neuroscientist. Each outcome lists its canonical endpoints. `aliases` are the endpoint keys (measurement.endpoint_normalized) that existing evidence rows use for that endpoint; a row whose key is in no alias list is unmapped and is not shown in the atlas. Two measurements are comparable only within the same endpoint. `visual` picks the schematic drawn on the outcome page (neurogenesis, spines, branching, survival) or null for outcomes that are not a shape or a count of cells.

outcomes.label: Adult neurogenesis
outcomes.description: New neurons: proliferating progenitor cells and newborn neurons that survive.

outcomes.label: Dendritic spine density
outcomes.description: Spinogenesis: spines per length of dendrite, and how fast spines form or are lost.

outcomes.label: Dendritic complexity
outcomes.description: Dendritogenesis: branching and length of the dendritic tree.

outcomes.label: Synaptic markers
outcomes.description: Proteins used as markers of synapse number or strength.

outcomes.label: Neuron survival or loss
outcomes.description: Neurodegenerative features: how many neurons survive, die or are lost.
